convert_scannet_to_coco: convert ScanNet dataset to COCO format for a given phase and optional 200-class mode
read_txt: read a text file into a list of stripped lines
polygons_to_bitmask: convert polygon coordinates to a binary bitmask array of specified height and width
run_scannet2coco_cli: run the scannet2coco CLI module with optional --scannet200 flag to generate COCO JSON output
create_coco_categories: create COCO category lists from ScanNet 20 or 200 class name mappings
